meta.name: Create multi-platform social posts with DeepSeek, Gemini, Google Sheets, and gotoHuman

name: Automated Multi-Platform Content Publisher (AI + Human Approval)

parameters.content:
## Capture voice context

Receives a new content idea from the form, retrieves voice-card data from Google Sheets, and selects the latest voice card for generation context.

## Generate core message

Uses DeepSeek to create the central message, parses the response, and assigns a unique content item ID.

## Create content record

Creates the initial content item in Google Sheets and prepares shared input for the platform-specific drafting branches.

## Draft LinkedIn content

Generates a LinkedIn draft, runs a voice-quality review with DeepSeek, and formats the LinkedIn draft for merging.

## Draft Instagram caption

Generates an Instagram caption and visual concept, parses the AI JSON, and formats the Instagram draft output.

## Draft X thread

Generates an X thread, parses the AI JSON response, and formats the thread as a standardized draft item.

## Generate Instagram image

Creates an Instagram image with Gemini, extracts the base64 image data, converts it to binary, and uploads it to Google Drive.

## Aggregate drafts for review

Merges the platform drafts, aggregates them into a single content package, updates Google Sheets, and sends the human review request.

## Receive approval decision

Starts when gotoHuman returns a review result, parses the review payload, and branches based on whether the content was approved.

## Publish approved posts

Publishes approved content to LinkedIn, Instagram, and X using the respective platform APIs.

## Handle publish results

Checks whether any platform publish request failed, prepares a failure notification if needed, or marks the item as published in Google Sheets.

## Mark rejected content

Updates Google Sheets when the human reviewer rejects the proposed content.

## Load published items

Runs on the weekly schedule, reads published content records from Google Sheets, and filters items that should have performance metrics collected.

## Score content performance

Fetches social performance metrics and scores each item to identify top-performing content.

## Save performance insights

Writes performance data to Google Sheets, checks whether an item is a top performer, and adds qualifying examples to the voice library.

parameters.content:
## 🤖 Automated Multi-Platform Content Publisher (AI + Human Approval)

This workflow turns a single raw idea into ready-to-post drafts for LinkedIn, Instagram, and X, written in your own voice. All three go through one approval screen before anything is posted, and gets published automatically once approved. It also learns over time from how your posts actually perform.

### 🧩 Why This Isn't Just a Content Calendar Tool
Most content schedulers either make you write everything yourself, or generate generic AI copy that reads like everyone else's. This workflow instead:
• Bases every draft on a voice profile built from your own past writing, not a generic AI prompt
• Runs a second pass on the LinkedIn draft that checks it against your voice and rewrites anything that sounds like generic AI writing
• Sends all three platforms through one approval screen, instead of approving each platform separately
• Adds real engagement data from published posts back into the voice profile, so future drafts keep getting better

### 🔍 What It Does
This workflow:
• Takes a raw idea from a form and turns it into a short core message
• Writes a LinkedIn post, an Instagram caption, and an X thread from that message, each written for that platform
• Generates a matching image for the Instagram post
• Sends all three drafts to a human reviewer to approve or reject in one screen
• Publishes to all three platforms automatically once approved, retrying if a post fails
• Every week, checks how published posts actually performed and saves the best ones as examples for future drafts

### ⚙️ How It Works
• A Form Trigger captures the idea; a Sheets lookup pulls the current voice profile
• DeepSeek turns the idea into a short thesis plus supporting points, based on that voice profile
• Three branches run in parallel to write the LinkedIn, Instagram, and X drafts; LinkedIn gets an extra voice-check pass, Instagram also generates an image via Gemini
• All three drafts are combined into one record, saved to Google Sheets, and sent to gotoHuman for review
• A gotoHuman Trigger fires when the reviewer responds; approved content is published to each platform with retry logic, rejected content is just logged
• A separate weekly schedule checks engagement on published posts, scores them, and saves the best ones to a Voice Library Examples sheet

### 💪 Key Capabilities
• Drafts are based on a real voice profile, with an extra rewrite pass to catch generic AI phrasing
• One approval screen for all three platforms instead of a separate approval for each
• Publishing retries automatically and notifies you if it still fails, instead of failing silently
• The voice profile improves over time using real engagement data
• Uses DeepSeek to keep AI costs low, but works with any OpenAI-compatible model

### 📦 Requirements
• Google Sheets (4 tabs: Voice Library, Content Items, Performance, Voice Library Examples) + OAuth credential
• DeepSeek API key (or any OpenAI-compatible model)
• Gemini API key for Instagram visuals (optional — the workflow still runs fine without it)
• gotoHuman account + a review template with 3 long-text fields: linkedinDraft, instagramDraft, xThread
• OAuth credentials for LinkedIn, Instagram Graph API, and X

### 💡 Example Use Cases
• Solo creators or consultants who post on multiple platforms but only want to write one idea, not four separate drafts
• Agencies managing content for clients who need a person to approve posts before anything goes live
• Anyone tired of AI-written posts sounding the same as everyone else's — the voice-check pass exists specifically to fix that
• Teams who want a clear record of who approved what, and when, before anything gets published
